answer: Each identity must anchor itself to one unique external scarce resource — a distinct funding wallet or a registered domain — recorded in a crystal-clear public registry where one anchor backs exactly one identity, like separate springs feeding through karst rock: water from one spring cannot fill two caves. The anchor is re-checked every epoch with a micro-proof from that same source, and a velvet-rope rule admits no identity without a live anchor. A hundred fakes need a hundred distinct real anchors, each bought and maintained separately, so cost scales per clone and cannot be pooled.
